title: Minneapolis 311 Service Requests
description: Live 311 service requests from the City of Minneapolis: request type, subject, status, opened/closed timestamps and location. Filter by date, type or status. Years 2015 to today.
why: 311 is what residents complain about, by block, as it happens: potholes, graffiti, rodents, abandoned vehicles, snow. The city publishes every case; this actor reads it live and pages past ArcGIS's row cap.
useCases: Service businesses (pest control, snow removal, junk hauling) finding where demand is right now
Journalists and council staff tracking response times by type
Real-estate analysts reading block-level nuisance signals

openedSince.title: Opened on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)
openedSince.description: Only requests opened on or after this date.

type.title: Request type contains
type.description: e.g. Pothole, Graffiti, Rodent, Abandoned Vehicle

limits: Minneapolis only. The city posts 311 cases with a lag of a few weeks; CASESTATUS is the city's numeric code.
